question: Does the version-6-to-8 migration and shared freshness contract preserve existing writable databases and legacy portable archive reads sufficiently to land?
rationale: The implementation and tests substantially reduce risk, but accepting new persisted ordering semantics across canonical and derived state requires explicit store-owner judgment.

options.title: Complete store-owner review
options.body: Confirm the migration floor, legacy read-only fallback, and representative upgraded stores before merging.

options.title: Keep the branch draft
options.body: Pause landing until maintainers are prepared to own the new persistent ordering contract.

recommendation.title: Complete store-owner review
recommendation.body: Confirm the migration floor, legacy read-only fallback, and representative upgraded stores before merging.
